name: VCK-1 "Maul" Blade
description:
Renowned as Humanity's fiercest enemy, the weapons wielded by the Vanduul are some of the most feared in the universe. Taking inspiration from those brutal knives, the VCK-1 from UltiFlex features a split blade, ceremonial detailing, and has been finished with a unique patina that closely resembles the Vanduul's own bespoke alloys.

The Maul edition features dark metal and red detailing.
